primaryReader: Market design stress-tester / systems engineer / experimental economics researcher
readerProblem: Assuming collective mechanisms can be proven on trivial commodity goods without testing severe perishability and heterogeneous constraint friction.

propositionLedger.statement: Travel maximizes non-compensable constraint variance (dates, health, family, mobility), serving as an ideal failure-discovery stress test.
GOLIAF is a bounded analytical research environment, not a commercial booking service or discount club.
Failure to coordinate complex travel positions is a primary, valid research finding that maps the boundaries of demand-side agency.

outsideOptionDependencies: Highly optimized individual retail travel fallback
prohibitedInterpretations: Do not claim GOLIAF is a live booking tool, club, or waitlist.
Do not promise travel discounts or supplier agreements.
claimBoundary: Conceptual research framework at Evidence Level E0. GOLIAF stress-test environment.
handoff: Supplies empirical and analytical failure criteria to Module 07 (What Counts as Success).
